metadata.title: Comprehensive SEO & AEO Rules and Guidelines
metadata.description: Complete reference of SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) rules compiled from Google, Bing, and authoritative third-party sources. Covers technical SEO, on-page optimization, structured data, AI search optimization, and monitoring.

title_tags.name: Title Tags
title_tags.description: Rules for HTML <title> elements which appear as the clickable headline in search results. Titles are a strong ranking signal for both Google and Bing.

rules.description: Google truncates titles based on pixel width (roughly 600px on desktop). Bing recommends under 65 characters. Keep titles concise to avoid truncation in SERPs.
rules.implementation: Set <title> content to 60 characters max for safety. Use a character counter during content creation. For Bing, aim for under 65 characters.
rules.validation: Run a crawl tool (Screaming Frog) to check all page titles. Flag any over 60 characters. Use Google Search Console to see how titles render.

rules.rule: Place primary keyword in first part of title
rules.description: Front-loading the primary keyword improves relevance signals and ensures visibility even if truncated.
rules.implementation: Structure titles as: Primary Keyword - Secondary Info | Brand. Example: 'JSON Formatter - Free Online Tool | ZTools' rather than 'ZTools | JSON Formatter Tool'.
rules.validation: For each page, verify the target keyword appears within the first 30 characters of the title tag.

rules.rule: Each page must have a unique descriptive title
rules.description: Duplicate titles confuse search engines about which page to rank. Every page should have a title that uniquely describes its content.
rules.implementation: Maintain a title inventory. For dynamic pages, use templates with unique identifiers. Never use the same title for multiple URLs.
rules.validation: Crawl the site and export all title tags. Sort and check for duplicates. Google Search Console reports duplicate titles under 'Page indexing'.

rules.rule: Title must match visible H1/primary heading
rules.description: The title tag and H1 should reinforce each other. They don't need to be identical but should convey the same topic.
rules.implementation: When setting page titles, ensure the H1 covers the same primary topic. Core keyword/topic must align.
rules.validation: For each page, compare <title> with <h1>. Flag pages where primary keyword differs between them.

rules.description: Including brand name builds recognition and trust. Use dash, pipe, or colon as delimiter.
rules.implementation: Use consistent pattern: 'Page Topic - Brand Name' or 'Page Topic | Brand Name'. Brand at end for most pages.
rules.validation: Check all titles follow chosen brand delimiter pattern. Verify consistency.

rules.rule: No keyword stuffing or repeated words in titles
rules.description: Repeating keywords looks spammy and can trigger Google to rewrite the title or demote the page.
rules.implementation: Use each keyword once. Avoid 'Free JSON Formatter | JSON Format | JSON Formatting Tool'. Instead: 'Free JSON Formatter - Format & Validate JSON | ZTools'.
rules.validation: Review titles for repeated words. No word should appear more than twice. Use a script to flag repetitive titles.

rules.description: Titles like 'Home', 'Profile', 'Page 1' provide no ranking signal and poor UX.
rules.implementation: Every page must have descriptive title. Homepage: 'ZTools - 500+ Free Online Developer Tools'. Profile: 'Your Profile Settings | ZTools'.
rules.validation: Crawl and flag generic titles (Home, Untitled, Page, Profile without context).

rules.rule: Avoid boilerplate text repeated across pages
rules.description: Same long boilerplate in every title wastes characters and makes pages look identical in SERPs.
rules.implementation: Keep shared text minimal (just brand). Rest should be page-specific. Avoid 'MyBrand - The Best Tool Platform - [Page Name]' on every page.
rules.validation: Extract titles and check boilerplate percentage. Should be under 30%.

rules.rule: Title language must match page content language
rules.description: Mismatched languages confuse search engines about target audience.
rules.implementation: Set title in same language as primary content. Multilingual sites need properly translated titles.
rules.validation: Verify title language matches lang attribute and body content.

rules.rule: Google may rewrite titles if issues detected
rules.description: Google algorithmically rewrites titles it considers too long, stuffed, inaccurate, or boilerplate-heavy.
rules.implementation: Follow all title rules. If Google rewrites, check: too long? Matches H1? Keyword-stuffed? Fix underlying issue.
rules.validation: Compare titles in GSC (Search Results > Pages) with actual <title> tags. Investigate discrepancies.

meta_descriptions.name: Meta Descriptions
meta_descriptions.description: Rules for meta description tags that provide page summaries for search engine result snippets.

rules.description: Google truncates based on device width. Stay within 155-160 for desktop, core message in first 120 for mobile.
rules.implementation: Write descriptions 120-155 characters. Front-load important information. Include call-to-action.
rules.validation: Crawl all pages. Flag under 25 (too short) or over 160 (truncated).

rules.rule: Write unique descriptions for each page
rules.description: Duplicate descriptions waste opportunity to differentiate pages in results.
rules.implementation: Create unique description for every indexable page. Use templates with variables for dynamic pages.
rules.validation: Export all descriptions. Sort and check for duplicates. GSC flags duplicates.

rules.description: For articles: author/date. For products: price. For tools: what it does. Specifics increase CTR.
rules.implementation: Articles: 'By [Author] - [Date]. [Summary].' Tools: 'Free online [tool]. [What it does] instantly.'
rules.validation: Review descriptions per content type. Verify appropriate details included.

rules.rule: Must be truly descriptive and human-readable
rules.description: Descriptions should read as natural sentences. They serve as ad copy in search results.
rules.implementation: Write 1-2 complete sentences. Include primary keyword naturally. Add value proposition or CTA.
rules.validation: Read aloud. Should sound natural and compelling. Flag keyword lists or incoherent descriptions.

rules.description: Comma-separated keyword lists may cause Google to ignore your description entirely.
rules.implementation: Instead of 'JSON formatter, JSON validator, JSON beautifier', write 'Format, validate, and beautify JSON with our free online tool.'
rules.validation: Check for 3+ comma-separated keywords without sentence structure. Rewrite.

rules.rule: Google does NOT use meta keywords tag for ranking
rules.description: The <meta name='keywords'> tag has been ignored by Google since 2009 and Bing since 2014.
rules.implementation: Don't waste time on meta keywords tags. Focus on title and description.
rules.validation: Optional: check if meta keywords exist. Harmless but unnecessary.

rules.description: Prevent or limit snippet display with meta robots directives.
rules.implementation: Prevent: <meta name='robots' content='nosnippet'>. Limit: content='max-snippet:150'>. Exclude sections: data-nosnippet attribute.
rules.validation: Check snippet directives. Verify intentional, not accidentally blocking important pages.

headings_structure.name: Headings Structure
headings_structure.description: Rules for HTML heading elements (H1-H6) that define content hierarchy and help search engines understand page structure.

rules.rule: One H1 per page as main topic indicator
rules.description: Best practice is one H1 per page clearly stating the primary topic.
rules.implementation: Every page: exactly one <h1>. First heading, describes main topic.
rules.validation: Crawl and count H1s per page. Flag 0 or 2+ H1 tags.

rules.rule: Check UI library Heading defaults — Radix UI defaults to h1
rules.description: Radix UI Themes Heading component defaults to as='h1' when no as prop is specified. This silently creates multiple H1 tags. Always use as='h2' or as='h3' for non-primary headings. Same issue may apply to other component libraries.
rules.implementation: Every <Heading> without as='h1' must explicitly set as='h2' or as='h3'. Only the page's primary heading should be as='h1'.
rules.validation: grep '<Heading' src/ | grep -v 'as=' to find implicit H1s. Crawl pages and count rendered <h1> elements.

rules.rule: H1 must be visible, not hidden with CSS
rules.description: Hiding H1 with display:none, visibility:hidden, font-size:0 is considered deceptive.
rules.implementation: H1 must be visually rendered. Redesign if needed rather than hiding. sr-only/clip for accessibility is acceptable.
rules.validation: Inspect H1 for hiding CSS properties. Only sr-only/clip acceptable.

rules.description: H2 headings break the page into major sections under H1.
rules.implementation: Under H1, use H2 for each major section. Each H2 introduces distinct subtopic.
rules.validation: Review page outlines. Each H2 should represent meaningful subtopic.

rules.rule: Semantic H1-H6 hierarchy for structure not styling
rules.description: Headings for document structure, not visual styling. Use CSS for sizing.
rules.implementation: Follow logical hierarchy: H1>H2>H3>H4. Don't skip levels. Don't use headings for styling.
rules.validation: Extract heading outline. Verify no skipped levels. Check headings aren't purely for styling.

rules.description: Nesting communicates topic relationships. Content under H3 is subtopic of preceding H2.
rules.implementation: Treat headings like outline: H1=title, H2=chapters, H3=sections within chapters.
rules.validation: Generate heading outline. Verify it reads logically as table of contents.

rules.rule: No penalty for order violations but best practice
rules.description: Google confirmed no ranking penalty for heading order violations. Proper order still best practice.
rules.implementation: Always aim for proper order. Fix legacy issues but don't panic.
rules.validation: Use HTML validator to flag out-of-order headings. Fix on high-traffic pages.

rules.rule: H1 content should match and reinforce title tag
rules.description: H1 and title should convey same primary topic. Core message must align.
rules.implementation: If title is 'JSON Formatter - Free Tool | ZTools', H1 should be 'JSON Formatter' or similar.
rules.validation: Compare title and H1 per page. Primary keyword should match.

content_quality.name: Content Quality
content_quality.description: Rules for creating high-quality, helpful content satisfying users and search engine quality guidelines.

rules.description: Google's Helpful Content system rewards content created primarily to help people.
rules.implementation: Ask: 'Would someone find this useful regardless of search engines?' Write from genuine expertise. Add unique insights.
rules.validation: Review against Google's helpful content questions: substantial value? Expert-written? Goes beyond obvious?

rules.description: Google evaluates content on creator's Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness. YMYL requires high E-E-A-T.
rules.implementation: Show credentials: author bios. Demonstrate experience: first-hand accounts. Build authority: cite sources. Build trust: accurate info, HTTPS.
rules.validation: Check: author identified? Credentials shown? Experience demonstrated? Claims sourced? HTTPS? About page?

rules.description: Unnaturally repeating keywords is a spam signal. Write naturally for humans.
rules.implementation: Use primary keyword 2-3 times naturally. Use synonyms. If awkward, rewrite naturally.
rules.validation: Calculate density (<2-3%). Read aloud. Check alt text and meta data.

rules.description: Duplicating content from other sites provides no unique value. Spam policies target this.
rules.implementation: All content must be original. Add substantial original analysis if referencing sources. Never copy-paste.
rules.validation: Use Copyscape. Check GSC for manual actions related to copied content.

rules.description: Outdated content loses relevance. Regular updates signal freshness.
rules.implementation: Review quarterly. Update statistics, check links, refresh examples. Show 'Last updated' dates.
rules.validation: Track update dates. Flag content not updated in 6+ months.

rules.description: Well-structured content improves readability and featured snippet/AI citation chances.
rules.implementation: 2-3 sentence paragraphs. Bullet lists for features/steps. Tables for comparisons. Bold key terms. Subheadings every 200-300 words.
rules.validation: Check paragraph length (<4 sentences). Verify lists/tables where appropriate.

rules.description: Core answer in first paragraph satisfies quick answers and increases AI citation.
rules.implementation: Start with direct answer. For 'What is JSON?', start with definition before history.
rules.validation: Check if first paragraph directly addresses primary topic. Key info in first paragraph?

rules.description: Visible author information builds E-E-A-T signals.
rules.implementation: Add author section: name, photo, role, qualifications, links. Use Person schema.
rules.validation: Check articles have visible author info with credentials. Check for Person schema.

rules.description: Changing dates without updating content is deceptive. Google detects this.
rules.implementation: Only update dateModified with substantive changes. Keep changelog.
rules.validation: Compare dateModified changes with actual content diffs.

rules.description: 10 comprehensive 2000-word articles outperform 50 shallow 500-word articles.
rules.implementation: Aim to be most comprehensive resource. Cover all aspects, answer questions, include examples and data.
rules.validation: Compare depth with top-ranking competitors. Should cover equal or more subtopics.

rules.description: Including primary keyword early confirms topic. Reinforces title and H1 signals.
rules.implementation: Include keyword in first 100 words naturally. Should happen organically with BLUF.
rules.validation: Check if target keyword appears in first 100 words.

urls.name: URL Structure
urls.description: Rules for clean, descriptive URLs that help users and search engines understand page content.

rules.description: URLs should be readable and give clear idea of page content. Avoid query strings, random IDs.
rules.implementation: Use /tools/json-formatter not /tool?id=47. Include keywords. Lowercase only.
rules.validation: Review sitemap URLs. Flag query parameters, random IDs, non-descriptive segments.

rules.description: Google treats hyphens as word separators, underscores as joiners. 'json-formatter' = two words.
rules.implementation: Always hyphens (-). Never underscores (_), spaces (%20), or camelCase.
rules.validation: Crawl URLs. Flag underscores or spaces. Set up redirects if both versions exist.

rules.description: Shorter URLs are easier to share and display. Include primary keyword.
rules.implementation: 3-5 words in path. Remove stop words. /blog/json-guide not /blog/the-complete-guide-to-json-formatting-in-2026.
rules.validation: Flag URLs over 75 characters in path.

rules.rule: Group topically similar pages in directories
rules.description: Logical directory structure helps search engines understand site organization.
rules.implementation: Group: /tools/json/formatter, /tools/json/validator. Consistent directory naming.
rules.validation: Review URL hierarchy. Similar content should share parent directories.

rules.rule: Keywords in domain/path have minimal ranking effect
rules.description: Google confirmed keywords in URL have minimal direct ranking effect.
rules.implementation: Choose domains for brand identity, not keyword matching. Include keywords in paths for user clarity.
rules.validation: Informational - don't over-optimize URLs for keywords.

images.name: Image Optimization
images.description: Rules for optimizing images for search discovery, performance, and visual search results.

rules.description: Filenames are signals for image understanding. Describe content with keywords.
rules.implementation: Use 'json-formatter-screenshot.webp' not 'IMG_20260412_001.jpg'. Hyphens, 3-5 words.
rules.validation: Flag generic camera names (IMG_, DSC_, Screenshot_) or random strings.

rules.rule: Alt text describes image purpose in context
rules.description: Alt text should describe function on page, not just appearance. No keyword stuffing.
rules.implementation: Describe what image shows AND why it's there. 'JSON Formatter showing formatted output' not 'json formatter free online json'.
rules.validation: Flag missing alt, keyword-stuffed alt (5+ keywords), or generic alt ('image', 'photo').

rules.description: Purely decorative images should have alt='' to be skipped by screen readers.
rules.implementation: . Not alt='decorative image'.
rules.validation: Review decorative images for empty alt attribute.

rules.rule: Compress images and serve in modern formats
rules.description: Large images slow load, hurting Core Web Vitals. Use WebP/AVIF.
rules.implementation: Convert to WebP/AVIF. Use <picture> with fallbacks. Compress to 80-85% quality. Use srcset.
rules.validation: Flag JPEG/PNG that could be WebP/AVIF. Photos over 200KB need investigation. Run Lighthouse.

rules.rule: Set explicit width and height to prevent CLS
rules.description: Without dimensions, images cause layout shift hurting CLS scores.
rules.implementation: Add width and height to every . CSS aspect-ratio as alternative.
rules.validation: Flag missing width/height. Run Lighthouse CLS audit.

rules.description: LCP image should be prioritized. fetchpriority tells browser to load first.
rules.implementation: Identify LCP element. Add fetchpriority='high'. Ensure not lazy-loaded.
rules.validation: Use Lighthouse to identify LCP. Verify fetchpriority='high' and no loading='lazy'.

rules.description: Images must not overflow containers on mobile.
rules.implementation: CSS: img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }. Use srcset and sizes for responsive serving.
rules.validation: Test at 320px. No horizontal scroll from images.

rules.rule: Google does NOT index CSS background images
rules.description: Only with src are indexed. CSS background-image is not discoverable.
rules.implementation: For indexable images, use not CSS background-image.
rules.validation: Check if important images use CSS backgrounds. Convert to if needed.

rules.rule: Use image sitemaps for hard-to-discover images
rules.description: JS-loaded or behind-interaction images may need image sitemap.
rules.implementation: Add <image:image> in sitemap entries. Include URL, caption, title, license.
rules.validation: Verify important images in Google Images results. Add to sitemap if missing.

structured_data.name: Structured Data / Schema.org
structured_data.description: Rules for structured data markup enabling rich results and helping AI systems understand page content.

rules.description: Google recommends JSON-LD over Microdata or RDFa. Easier to implement and maintain.
rules.implementation: Add as <script type='application/ld+json'> in <head> or <body>. Don't use Microdata/RDFa for new implementations.
rules.validation: Check all structured data uses JSON-LD. Test with Rich Results Test and Schema.org Validator.

rules.rule: Embed in head or body as script tag
rules.description: JSON-LD can be placed anywhere in HTML. <head> preferred for clarity.
rules.implementation: Place in <head> for consistency. For SPAs, ensure present in server-rendered HTML.
rules.validation: View page source (not DevTools) to confirm structured data in initial HTML.

rules.rule: Must match visible page content exactly
rules.description: Structured data must accurately represent visible content. Violations result in manual actions.
rules.implementation: Every property should correspond to visible content. Rating 4.8 must be displayed. Price must be visible.
rules.validation: Compare structured data properties with visible content. Flag mismatches.

rules.rule: Only mark up genuinely present content
rules.description: Don't add schema for non-existent content types on the page.
rules.implementation: Audit each page's schema against actual content. Remove speculative markup.
rules.validation: For each schema type, verify corresponding content exists and is visible.

rules.rule: Use the most specific Schema.org type
rules.description: Use most specific type in hierarchy. SoftwareApplication not Thing. BlogPosting not Article.
rules.implementation: Check Schema.org hierarchy. Tools: SoftwareApplication. Blog: BlogPosting. Docs: TechArticle.
rules.validation: Review @type properties. Check for more specific subtypes.

rules.rule: Required schema types for key pages
rules.description: Homepage: WebSite+SearchAction+Organization. Interior: BreadcrumbList. Tools: SoftwareApplication. Blog: BlogPosting.
rules.implementation: Homepage: WebSite with SearchAction + Organization. All interior: BreadcrumbList. Tools: SoftwareApplication. Blog: BlogPosting with author, dates.
rules.validation: Checklist per page type. Verify with Rich Results Test.

rules.rule: Use stable @id values to connect entities
rules.description: Use @id identifiers referenced across structured data to build knowledge graph.
rules.implementation: URL-based @id: Organization @id: 'https://example.com/#organization'. Reference: 'publisher': {'@id': '...'}.
rules.validation: Check @id consistency across pages. Verify cross-references match.

rules.description: Only add if real user ratings displayed. Fake ratings result in penalties.
rules.implementation: Only add if: real rating system, actual users, displayed on page, accurate values.
rules.validation: For every AggregateRating, verify rating visually displayed and matches values.

rules.rule: Validate with Rich Results Test and Schema.org Validator
rules.description: Always validate before deploying. Both tools catch different issues.
rules.implementation: Test with: Rich Results Test, Schema.org Validator, Bing Markup Validator. Fix all errors.
rules.validation: Run both validators on representative pages. Zero errors required.

rules.description: Google restricted FAQPage rich results to government/health sites in August 2023.
rules.implementation: Don't rely on FAQPage for rich results. Keep for AI/semantic purposes or remove.
rules.validation: If FAQPage exists, understand no rich results. Keep for AI or remove.

rules.rule: HowTo rich results deprecated since September 2023
rules.description: HowTo no longer produces visual rich results in Google.
rules.implementation: Don't add HowTo expecting rich results. Keep for semantic value or remove.
rules.validation: Check for HowTo schema. Decide: keep for semantic value or remove.

rules.rule: Structured data enables rich results, not direct ranking boost
rules.description: Doesn't directly boost rankings. Enables rich results improving CTR ~35%.
rules.implementation: Implement for rich result benefits and AI understanding, not as ranking factor.
rules.validation: Monitor rich results in GSC Enhancements. Track CTR changes.

rules.rule: ~35% higher CTR with proper structured data
rules.description: Pages with rich results have ~35% higher click-through rates.
rules.implementation: Prioritize types producing visible rich results: Product, Article, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication.
rules.validation: Compare CTR for pages with/without rich results in GSC.

robots_txt.name: Robots.txt
robots_txt.description: Rules for the robots.txt file controlling search engine crawler access.

rules.description: Must be at domain root, case-sensitive, lowercase, UTF-8 encoded.
rules.implementation: Create at web root. Serve with text/plain. UTF-8 encoding.
rules.validation: Access /robots.txt in browser. Verify 200 status and text/plain content type.

rules.description: Controls whether bots crawl pages. Does NOT prevent indexing. Use noindex for that.
rules.implementation: Prevent crawling: robots.txt Disallow. Prevent indexing: <meta noindex>. Don't block AND noindex (bot can't see noindex if blocked).
rules.validation: Check if blocked pages still appear in results. If so, need noindex instead.

rules.rule: Include Sitemap directive with absolute URL
rules.description: Sitemap directive tells bots where to find your sitemap.
rules.implementation: Add: Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml. Absolute URL with HTTPS.
rules.validation: Check for Sitemap directive. Verify absolute URL. Access sitemap URL.

rules.rule: Never block CSS/JS files needed for rendering
rules.description: Bots need to render pages. Blocking CSS/JS prevents proper rendering.
rules.implementation: Don't Disallow /static/, /assets/, /css/, /js/. Be specific if blocking.
rules.validation: Use URL Inspection to check rendering. If different from user view, check robots.txt.

rules.description: Bing respects Crawl-delay. Google does NOT (use Search Console).
rules.implementation: For Bing: User-agent: Bingbot / Crawl-delay: 5. Only if server load is issue.
rules.validation: Check Crawl-delay in robots.txt. Verify under Bing-specific block.

rules.description: Supports * (any chars) and $ (end of URL) for precise blocking.
rules.implementation: Block PDFs: /*.pdf$. Block params: /*?sort=. Block patterns: /admin/*.
rules.validation: Test patterns with robots.txt testers. Verify matches.

rules.rule: Test with robots.txt testers before deploying
rules.description: Misconfigured robots.txt can block important pages.
rules.implementation: Use GSC and Bing Webmaster Tools testers. Test critical URLs.
rules.validation: After changes, test: homepage, landing pages, sitemap, CSS/JS files.

meta_robots.name: Meta Robots Tags
meta_robots.description: Rules for meta robots tags and X-Robots-Tag HTTP header controlling indexing and snippet behavior.

rules.description: No tag needed for default behavior. Only add to change defaults.
rules.implementation: Don't add redundant 'index, follow'. Only add when changing default.
rules.validation: Remove any 'index, follow' only tags.

rules.description: Tells search engines not to include page in index. Crawler must access page to see it.
rules.implementation: Apply to: admin, thank-you, internal search, staging, user-specific pages. Don't block in robots.txt AND noindex.
rules.validation: Search site:yourdomain.com for noindex pages appearing. Monitor GSC.

rules.description: Tells bots not to follow or pass signals through links. Use sparingly.
rules.implementation: Use for untrusted/UGC pages. For individual links, use rel='nofollow' on <a> tag.
rules.validation: Review pages with nofollow. Ensure intentional.

rules.description: Prevents cached copy display. Bing: 'nocache', Google: 'noarchive'.
rules.implementation: Use for rapidly changing or privacy-sensitive content.
rules.validation: Check important pages don't have unneeded noarchive/nocache.

rules.description: Page appears with only title and URL. Generally not recommended.
rules.implementation: Use only with specific reason. Snippets help CTR.
rules.validation: Verify nosnippet is intentional on affected pages.

rules.description: Limits text snippet to N characters. -1 for no limit, 0 for none.
rules.implementation: <meta name='robots' content='max-snippet:150'>.
rules.validation: If set, verify allows enough text (100+ chars).

rules.description: Options: none, standard, large. 'large' required for Discover.
rules.implementation: Use 'large' for most pages for best visual presentation.
rules.validation: Check content pages have max-image-preview:large.

rules.description: Controls preview duration in seconds. -1 for no limit.
rules.implementation: Set to -1 (no limit) recommended.
rules.validation: If video, verify allows sufficient preview.

rules.description: HTML attribute excluding elements from snippets while allowing rest.
rules.implementation:
Excluded content
.
rules.validation: Verify data-nosnippet on correct elements only.

rules.rule: X-Robots-Tag HTTP header for non-HTML files
rules.description: Applies directives to PDFs, images, videos via HTTP header.
rules.implementation: Set in server config. Example: X-Robots-Tag: noindex.
rules.validation: Check HTTP headers of non-HTML resources.

rules.rule: Bot must crawl page to see meta robots
rules.description: If blocked by robots.txt, bot can't see meta directives.
rules.implementation: Don't combine robots.txt blocking with noindex. Allow crawling for noindex to work.
rules.validation: Cross-reference blocked URLs with noindex pages. Flag overlaps.

rules.rule: More restrictive directive wins when conflicting
rules.description: If index and noindex from different sources, noindex wins.
rules.implementation: Avoid conflicting directives across meta tags, HTTP headers, robots.txt.
rules.validation: Check all directive sources for conflicts.

sitemap_xml.name: XML Sitemap
sitemap_xml.description: Rules for creating and maintaining XML sitemaps for URL discovery.

rules.description: Only URLs returning 200, self-canonical, and indexable. No bad URLs.
rules.implementation: Filter: 200 OK, self-canonical, no noindex. Exclude redirects, 404s, noindex, non-canonical.
rules.validation: Crawl sitemap URLs. Flag non-200, noindex, or non-canonical.

rules.rule: No noindex, redirect, or blocked pages
rules.description: Including these contradicts their directives.
rules.implementation: Filter out noindex, redirecting, and robots.txt-blocked pages.
rules.validation: Cross-reference sitemap with noindex, redirects, robots.txt blocks.

rules.description: Max 50,000 URLs and 50MB uncompressed per file.
rules.implementation: Use sitemap index for larger sites.
rules.validation: Check file size (<50MB) and URL count (<50,000).

rules.description: Reflect actual content changes. Don't auto-set to today.
rules.implementation: Track real modification dates. ISO 8601 format.
rules.validation: Check dates against actual changes. Flag identical dates.

rules.rule: Submit in GSC and Bing Webmaster Tools
rules.description: Explicit submission ensures discovery and feedback.
rules.implementation: Submit in both tools. Re-submit after major changes.
rules.validation: Verify submitted and processed. Check for errors.

rules.description: Sitemap directive with absolute URL.
rules.implementation: Add: Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml
rules.validation: Check robots.txt for Sitemap directive.

rules.rule: Update when pages added, removed, or changed
rules.description: Keep sitemap current with live content.
rules.implementation: Automate generation in build process.
rules.validation: Compare sitemap with actual site URLs.

canonicalization.name: Canonicalization
canonicalization.description: Rules for canonical URLs preventing duplicate content and consolidating ranking signals.

rules.rule: Every indexable page should have self-referencing canonical
rules.description: Confirms preferred URL version. Prevents parameter/trailing slash issues.
rules.implementation: Add <link rel='canonical' href='...'> pointing to own clean URL on every page.
rules.validation: Crawl for missing canonical tags. Verify self-referencing correctness.

rules.description: Point all duplicate versions to preferred URL.
rules.implementation: Identify duplicates (/page and /page?ref=email). Point duplicate to preferred.
rules.validation: Verify duplicate groups all point to same canonical.

rules.rule: Never point canonical to noindex page
rules.description: Contradictory signals: canonical says index, noindex says don't.
rules.implementation: Audit canonical targets. None should have noindex.
rules.validation: Crawl canonical targets. Check for noindex.

rules.rule: Never point canonical to a redirect
rules.description: Should point to final destination, not redirecting URL.
rules.implementation: Canonical URLs must resolve with 200, not 301/302.
rules.validation: Check HTTP status of canonical targets. Flag redirects.

rules.rule: Only one canonical tag per page
rules.description: Multiple canonicals create ambiguity. May all be ignored.
rules.implementation: Check for duplicates from CMS plugins or template layering.
rules.validation: Parse rendered HTML. Count canonicals. Flag >1.

rules.description: Tags in <body> are ignored.
rules.implementation: Place between <head> and </head>. Ensure in server-rendered HTML for SPAs.
rules.validation: Verify canonical appears in <head> section.

indexing.name: Indexing Control
indexing.description: Rules for controlling which pages get indexed.

rules.description: Admin, thank-you, duplicates, staging, search results, login, profiles.
rules.implementation: Apply <meta name='robots' content='noindex'> to non-public pages.
rules.validation: List all page types. Verify noindex on non-public types.

rules.rule: robots.txt blocks crawling but NOT indexing
rules.description: Blocked pages can still appear in results if linked from elsewhere.
rules.implementation: Use noindex to prevent indexing. Don't block in robots.txt so crawler sees noindex.
rules.validation: Search site:yourdomain.com for blocked pages. Switch to noindex.

rules.description: noindex + GSC removal request + 404/410 for complete removal.
rules.implementation: Add noindex, submit removal request, return 404/410 for deleted content.
rules.validation: Monitor GSC for index status. Allow 2-4 weeks.

rules.description: 410 signals permanent removal for faster de-indexing.
rules.implementation: Return 410 for permanent, 404 for temporary. Don't redirect to homepage.
rules.validation: Check for soft 404s (200 status with 'not found' content).

rules.description: Zero traffic 12+ months = wasting crawl budget.
rules.implementation: Analyze 12 months GSC data. Improve, consolidate, redirect, or noindex zero-traffic pages.
rules.validation: Export GSC data. Filter zero-click pages in 12 months.

core_web_vitals.name: Core Web Vitals
core_web_vitals.description: Rules for meeting Google's Core Web Vitals performance thresholds.

rules.description: Largest Contentful Paint. Good: <2.5s. Poor: >4s.
rules.implementation: fetchpriority='high' on LCP image, preload critical resources, WebP/AVIF, eliminate render-blocking.
rules.validation: Test PageSpeed Insights. Monitor CrUX in GSC. Target <2.5s at 75th percentile.

rules.description: Cumulative Layout Shift. Good: <0.1. Poor: >0.25.
rules.implementation: Explicit width/height on images. Reserve space for ads. font-display: swap. No inserting above existing content.
rules.validation: Test PageSpeed Insights. Target <0.1 at 75th percentile.

rules.description: Interaction to Next Paint. Replaced FID March 2024. Good: <200ms. Poor: >500ms.
rules.implementation: scheduler.yield(), debounce handlers, defer non-critical JS, web workers for heavy computation.
rules.validation: Monitor CrUX in GSC. Target <200ms at 75th percentile.

rules.description: Preload LCP resource, compress images, fetchpriority='high', content-visibility: auto.
rules.implementation: Identify LCP with Lighthouse. Preload, fetchpriority='high', WebP/AVIF, remove render-blocking.
rules.validation: Run Lighthouse. Check LCP timing.

rules.rule: Fix CLS: explicit dimensions, reserved space, font-display
rules.description: Width/height on images, min-height for ads, font-display: swap.
rules.implementation: Images: always width/height. Ads: CSS min-height. Fonts: font-display: swap/optional.
rules.validation: Run Lighthouse CLS audit. Total <0.1.

rules.description: scheduler.yield(), debounce handlers, defer scripts, React.lazy.
rules.implementation: scheduler.yield() or requestIdleCallback. Debounce scroll/resize/input. async/defer on scripts.
rules.validation: Chrome DevTools Performance panel. No >200ms blocking during interaction.

mobile_first.name: Mobile-First Design
mobile_first.description: Rules for mobile-first design since Google uses mobile-first indexing.

rules.rule: Google uses mobile version for indexing/ranking
rules.description: Mobile version is what Google crawls, indexes, ranks.
rules.implementation: All content, links, structured data, meta tags on mobile. Responsive design. Test Mobile-Friendly.
rules.validation: URL Inspection in GSC. Compare mobile/desktop rendered pages.

rules.rule: Same content on mobile and desktop
rules.description: Hidden mobile content = hidden from Google's index.
rules.implementation: Don't hide content on mobile. Accordion/tab content should be in DOM.
rules.validation: Compare rendered content at mobile vs desktop widths.

rules.rule: Structured data must be on mobile pages
rules.description: JSON-LD must be in mobile HTML for mobile-first indexing.
rules.implementation: Ensure JSON-LD in mobile-served HTML. Automatic for responsive.
rules.validation: Test mobile URL with Rich Results Test.

rules.description: Text <16px difficult to read without zooming.
rules.implementation: Base font-size 16px. No important text <14px. Use rem/em.
rules.validation: Mobile-Friendly Test. Lighthouse 'Text too small'.

rules.description: Interactive elements 48x48px minimum with 8px+ spacing.
rules.implementation: Min 48px touch targets. 8px+ spacing. Use padding.
rules.validation: Lighthouse tap target audit. Flag <48px.

rules.description: Full-screen mobile popups lower rankings.
rules.implementation: No full-screen popups on mobile load. OK: small banners, legal notices.
rules.validation: Test landing pages on mobile for blocking popups.

rules.description: Google recommends responsive over separate mobile URLs.
rules.implementation: CSS media queries. <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>. Same HTML all devices.
rules.validation: Verify viewport meta. Test at multiple widths. No horizontal scroll.

https_security.name: HTTPS & Security
https_security.description: Rules for HTTPS implementation, a confirmed ranking signal.

rules.description: HTTPS is confirmed ranking signal. Must be valid, trusted, auto-renewing.
rules.implementation: Use Let's Encrypt or trusted CA. Auto-renewal. TLS 1.2+.
rules.validation: SSL Labs test. Verify auto-renewal. Monitor expiration.

rules.description: Every HTTP URL must 301 to HTTPS.
rules.implementation: Server-level 301 from http:// to https://. Add HSTS header.
rules.validation: Test HTTP URLs. Verify 301 to HTTPS. Check HSTS.

rules.description: Prevent unnecessary redirects and clean link graph.
rules.implementation: Use https:// or protocol-relative in all internal links.
rules.validation: Crawl internal links. Flag http://.

rules.description: Canonical URLs must use HTTPS.
rules.implementation: Ensure all canonicals use https://.
rules.validation: Crawl canonical URLs. Flag http://.

rules.description: All sitemap URLs must be HTTPS.
rules.implementation: Ensure sitemap generation uses https://.
rules.validation: Parse sitemap. Check all URLs start with https://.

rules.description: HTTPS pages must not load HTTP resources.
rules.implementation: All resources over HTTPS. Add CSP: upgrade-insecure-requests.
rules.validation: Chrome DevTools for mixed content warnings. Lighthouse security audit.

internal_linking.name: Internal Linking
internal_linking.description: Rules for effective internal link structure.

rules.description: Important pages need multiple contextual internal links.
rules.implementation: Ensure 2-6 pages link to each important page with relevant anchors.
rules.validation: Crawl tool: check internal link counts. Flag <2.

rules.description: Describe target page. Never 'click here' or 'read more'.
rules.implementation: 'Our JSON formatter tool' not 'click here'.
rules.validation: Extract anchor text. Flag generic anchors.

rules.description: Standard <a href> required for bot discovery.
rules.implementation: Always <a href='/path'>. No onClick-only navigation.
rules.validation: Check navigation uses <a href>. Disable JS to verify.

rules.rule: Every important page within 3 clicks of homepage
rules.description: Deep pages get less crawl priority.
rules.implementation: Use breadcrumbs, categories, footer links to reduce depth.
rules.validation: Measure click depth. Flag 4+ clicks.

rules.description: Pages with no internal links are undiscoverable.
rules.implementation: Every sitemap page needs at least one internal link.
rules.validation: Compare sitemap with crawled URLs. Orphans = in sitemap but not crawled.

rules.description: 404 links waste budget and hurt UX.
rules.implementation: Monthly crawl for broken links. Update, redirect, or remove.
rules.validation: Monthly crawl. Fix all broken links.

rules.description: A->B->C wastes budget. Link directly to C.
rules.implementation: Update internal links to final URL. Fix redirects to single-hop.
rules.validation: Crawl for chains. Target zero chains.

external_links.name: External Links
external_links.description: Rules for outbound links and link profile.

rules.description: Linking to spam hurts trust signals.
rules.implementation: Only reputable, authoritative sources.
rules.validation: Audit outbound links periodically.

rules.description: rel='nofollow' on UGC and untrusted links. rel='ugc' for UGC. rel='sponsored' for paid.
rules.implementation: nofollow on comments, user URLs. ugc for UGC. sponsored for paid.
rules.validation: Check UGC areas for missing nofollow/ugc.

rules.rule: Quality over quantity for inbound links
rules.description: Few high-authority links > hundreds of low-quality.
rules.implementation: Create link-worthy content. Build relationships. Avoid mass link-building.
rules.validation: Monitor in GSC and Bing. Disavow toxic if needed.

rules.description: Prohibited. Results in penalties.
rules.implementation: Never buy links. rel='sponsored' on paid links. Earn natural links.
rules.validation: Audit practices. Check GSC manual actions.

rules.description: Unnatural anchor profile signals manipulation.
rules.implementation: Don't over-optimize anchors. Use brand, URL, natural phrases.
rules.validation: Check distribution. >30% exact-match = suspicious.

rules.rule: No link farms, PBNs, or automated building
rules.description: All link schemes violate guidelines.
rules.implementation: No PBNs, link wheels, automated submissions. Build through relationships.
rules.validation: Review all link activities. Check GSC manual actions.

rules.description: Must return 404, not 200 (soft 404). Confuses search engines.
rules.implementation: Configure server for 404 on missing pages. SPAs: handle unknown routes with 404.
rules.validation: Request non-existent URLs. Verify 404 status. GSC reports soft 404s.

rules.description: 410 signals permanent removal for faster de-indexing.
rules.implementation: Return 410 for permanently removed. 404 for never-existed.
rules.validation: Verify deleted URLs return 410.

rules.rule: Custom 404 page with search and navigation
rules.description: Retains users hitting broken URLs.
rules.implementation: Include: search box, popular links, navigation, friendly message.
rules.validation: Visit non-existent URL. Verify custom 404, search, navigation, 404 status.

rules.description: Blanket homepage redirect = poor UX and confusing signals.
rules.implementation: Moved: 301 to new URL. Deleted: 404/410 with helpful page. Never mass-redirect.
rules.validation: Test non-existent URLs. None should redirect to homepage.

rules.description: Regular monitoring catches problems early.
rules.implementation: Check GSC and Bing weekly. Alert on spikes.
rules.validation: Review reports. Track counts. Investigate increases.

rules.description: Internal 404 links indicate poor maintenance.
rules.implementation: Crawl regularly. Update, redirect, or remove broken links.
rules.validation: Monthly crawl. Target zero broken internal links.

ai_search_optimization.name: AI Search Optimization (AEO)
ai_search_optimization.description: Rules for AI-powered search engines, LLMs, and answer engines.

rules.description: Don't block: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Amazonbot, Applebot, cohere-ai, YouBot, BraveBot, Bytespider, FacebookBot, CCBot.
rules.implementation: Don't block AI crawler user agents. Ensure User-agent: * doesn't block important content.
rules.validation: Review robots.txt for AI crawler blocks. Test each user-agent.

rules.rule: Consider creating llms.txt at site root
rules.description: Emerging standard providing LLMs guidance about your site.
rules.implementation: Create /llms.txt with: site description, content categories, citation format, key pages, licensing.
rules.validation: Access /llms.txt. Verify useful information.

rules.description: AI parses headings to extract sections. Clear headings improve citation.
rules.implementation: Question-format headings: 'What Is JSON?' not 'Introduction'. Self-explanatory.
rules.validation: Read heading outline. Each should clearly indicate content topic.

rules.description: AI prefers concise, extractable content.
rules.implementation: 2-3 sentences per paragraph. Start with key point. Answer immediately after question headings.
rules.validation: Paragraphs under 100 words. First sentences contain key info.

rules.rule: Definition lists 30-40% more cited by LLMs
rules.description: HTML <dl>/<dt>/<dd> particularly effective for AI citation.
rules.implementation: Use for glossaries, features, FAQ. <dl><dt>Term</dt><dd>Definition</dd></dl>.
rules.validation: Identify suitable content. Verify proper HTML structure.

rules.description: Core answer in first sentence maximizes citation likelihood.
rules.implementation: Sentence 1 = answer, 2-3 = evidence, rest = examples. Inverted pyramid.
rules.validation: First sentence of each section: standalone answer?

rules.description: Sourced statistics = 30-40% more AI visibility.
rules.implementation: Specific numbers from authoritative sources. Inline citations. Update annually.
rules.validation: Check for unsourced claims. Verify statistics current (<2 years).

rules.description: AI favors fresh content. Quarterly = maintenance signal.
rules.implementation: Quarterly reviews. Update statistics, examples, dateModified. Show 'Last updated'.
rules.validation: Flag >3 months stale. Verify dateModified reflects real changes.

rules.description: AI aggregates from multiple sources.
rules.implementation: Profiles on Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, Stack Overflow, GitHub. Cross-reference website.
rules.validation: Check brand on major platforms. Verify website links.

rules.rule: IndexNow for fast AI feed updates
rules.description: Updates to Bing, Yandex, ChatGPT feeds within minutes.
rules.implementation: Implement IndexNow API. Host key file. POST URLs on changes. CDN one-click integration.
rules.validation: Verify key file. Check Bing Webmaster Tools.

rules.rule: No special markup for Google AI Overviews
rules.description: Standard SEO is the pathway.
rules.implementation: Standard SEO best practices. Clear, comprehensive content.
rules.validation: Monitor AI Overviews in GSC.

rules.rule: Standard SEO is pathway to AI features
rules.description: Strong SEO = AI search visibility.
rules.implementation: Don't treat AEO separate from SEO. Quality content, technical SEO, E-E-A-T, structured data, UX.
rules.validation: Track traditional rankings and AI citations. Should correlate.

social_signals.name: Social Signals & Open Graph
social_signals.description: Rules for social signals and sharing markup.

rules.rule: Bing uses social signals as ranking factor
rules.description: Bing confirms social signals influence rankings.
rules.implementation: Active social presence. Consistent sharing. Authoritative engagement.
rules.validation: Monitor Bing rankings with social activity.

rules.description: Established accounts carry more weight.
rules.implementation: Build relationships with authoritative accounts. Share-worthy content.
rules.validation: Track who shares content. Note verified accounts.

rules.description: Control appearance on Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.
rules.implementation: og:title, og:description, og:image (1200x630), og:url, og:type, og:site_name per page.
rules.validation: Facebook Sharing Debugger. Verify rendering.

rules.description: Control appearance on Twitter/X.
rules.implementation: twitter:card (summary_large_image), twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image.
rules.validation: Twitter Card Validator. Verify rendering.

rules.description: 1.91:1 ratio for proper cross-platform display.
rules.implementation: 1200x630px. Descriptive visuals. JPEG/PNG. Fast CDN.
rules.validation: Check og:image dimensions. Test on platforms.

publication_dates.name: Publication Dates
publication_dates.description: Rules for publication and modification date markup.

rules.description: Display dates visibly with 'Published'/'Updated' labels.
rules.implementation: Show: 'Published: January 15, 2026' or 'Last updated: April 10, 2026'. Near title.
rules.validation: Check dated content has visible dates with clear labels.

rules.rule: datePublished and dateModified in structured data
rules.description: ISO 8601 format in Article/BlogPosting schema.
rules.implementation: 'datePublished': '2026-01-15T09:00:00+05:00'. Always ISO 8601 with timezone.
rules.validation: Check structured data dates. Verify format. Compare with visible dates.

rules.description: Future dates are deceptive and confuse algorithms.
rules.implementation: Validate dates. datePublished not in future.
rules.validation: Check for future dates in structured data or visible.

rules.rule: Match visible dates with structured data
rules.description: Discrepancies cause search engines to ignore dates.
rules.implementation: Update visible date and structured data simultaneously.
rules.validation: Compare visible and structured data dates per page.

rules.description: Removes ambiguity in ISO 8601.
rules.validation: Check for timezone in structured data dates.

rules.description: Multiple dates confuse which is publication date.
rules.implementation: Article date most prominent. Other dates less prominent. Structured data clarifies.
rules.validation: Check for multiple dates. Ensure article date is primary.

favicon.name: Favicon
favicon.description: Rules for favicons in search results and browser tabs.

rules.rule: Favicon link tag in homepage header
rules.description: Google uses homepage <link> tag.
rules.implementation: <link rel='icon'> in <head>. Include apple-touch-icon.
rules.validation: Check homepage for favicon links. Access URLs.

rules.description: Google recommends 48x48px or multiples.
rules.implementation: Multiple sizes: 16, 32, 48, 180, 192. SVG for scaling.
rules.validation: Check dimensions. Ensure 48x48+ exists.

rules.description: Non-square will be distorted.
rules.implementation: Width equals height. Center in square canvas.
rules.validation: Verify all favicon files are square.

rules.description: Blocked favicon won't display in results.
rules.implementation: Don't block favicon in robots.txt.
rules.validation: Test favicon URL against robots.txt.

rules.description: Google caches. Changes take weeks.
rules.implementation: Stable URL: /favicon.ico, /favicon.svg.
rules.validation: Verify URL hasn't changed recently.

site_name.name: Site Name
site_name.description: Rules for site name in search results.

rules.description: Google uses WebSite structured data for site name.
rules.implementation: WebSite schema with name, url, SearchAction on homepage.
rules.validation: Check homepage for WebSite schema. Rich Results Test.

rules.description: Should uniquely represent your site.
rules.implementation: Unique, brand-consistent name. Not generic.
rules.validation: Search site name - should uniquely identify site.

rules.description: 1-3 words matching audience recognition.
rules.implementation: Shortest recognized name. No taglines.
rules.validation: WebSite schema 'name' should be concise brand only.

rules.description: Multiple sources, priority order.
rules.implementation: Set consistently: WebSite schema, og:site_name, title brand, header.
rules.validation: Verify consistency across all sources.

rules.description: Discover via <video>, <embed>, <iframe>.
rules.implementation: <video> for self-hosted, <iframe> for embedded. In initial HTML.
rules.validation: Check video pages for proper HTML elements.

rules.description: Enables rich video results.
rules.implementation: VideoObject: name, description, thumbnailUrl, uploadDate, contentUrl/embedUrl.
rules.validation: Rich Results Test. GSC Video Indexing.

rules.description: Helps discover dynamic/JS videos.
rules.implementation: Video sitemap with video-specific metadata.
rules.validation: Verify valid and complete.

rules.rule: Unique page per video with text
rules.description: Dedicated page with surrounding text content.
rules.implementation: Title, summary, transcript, related content per video.
rules.validation: 200+ words text. Each video has own URL.

rules.description: For rich results display.
rules.implementation: High-quality 1280x720+. Stable URL.
rules.validation: Check dimensions and accessibility.

rules.description: Most widely supported.
rules.implementation: MP4 (H.264) primary. WebM fallback. Not blocked.
rules.validation: Check formats. MP4 available.

rules.rule: Video elements in initial page load
rules.description: Don't rely on user interaction to load.
rules.implementation: HTML elements in initial render. Lazy-load file OK.
rules.validation: View source for video elements.

rules.description: Every page must reference itself.
rules.implementation: Include self-referencing hreflang with all language versions.
rules.validation: Check every hreflang page includes self-reference.

rules.description: If A references B, B must reference A.
rules.implementation: When adding X->Y, also update Y to reference X.
rules.validation: Crawl hreflang. Verify bidirectional. Flag unidirectional.

rules.description: Fallback for unmatched languages.
rules.implementation: hreflang='x-default' on all pages with hreflang.
rules.validation: Check all hreflang pages for x-default.

rules.description: ISO 639-1 language + optional ISO 3166-1 region.
rules.implementation: Correct: en-US, en-GB, fr-CA, pt-BR. Common mistakes: 'uk' not 'en-GB', 'jp' not 'ja'.
rules.validation: Verify valid ISO codes. Use validation tools.

javascript_rendering.name: JavaScript & Rendering
javascript_rendering.description: Rules for JS-heavy sites and SPAs.

rules.description: ISR/SSG provides fully rendered HTML for best SEO.
rules.implementation: Use ISR/SSG where possible. SSR for dynamic. Pre-rendering if CSR unavoidable.
rules.validation: View page source. Content in initial HTML.

rules.rule: Serve content with 200 OK before JS execution
rules.description: Initial response should contain meaningful content.
rules.implementation: Server-render critical content: title, meta, heading, primary text.
rules.validation: curl page. Should contain content, not empty div#root.

rules.description: Static content doesn't need JS hydration.
rules.implementation: Island architecture. Static as server HTML. Only hydrate interactive components.
rules.validation: Check JS bundle and hydration time.

rules.description: See exactly what Google sees.
rules.implementation: Check every page type in GSC URL Inspection. Compare with user view.
rules.validation: URL Inspection on representative pages.

rules.description: Text via ::before/::after not visible to search engines.
rules.implementation: Never place important content in CSS content property.
rules.validation: Search CSS for content: with meaningful text.

rules.rule: SPAs need unique URLs per screen
rules.description: Each view must have own URL.
rules.implementation: Client-side routing updating URLs. History API. Direct navigation support.
rules.validation: Navigate SPA. URL changes per screen. Copy URL to new tab: correct content.

crawl_budget.name: Crawl Budget
crawl_budget.description: Rules for efficient crawl budget management.

rules.description: Small sites fully crawled. Large sites need optimization.
rules.implementation: Prioritize important pages. Remove low-value. Fix errors. Fast responses.
rules.validation: GSC Crawl Stats. Monitor rate and pages crawled.

rules.description: Sort/filter/session params create huge URL spaces.
rules.implementation: Block params in robots.txt. Canonical tags. Configure in GSC.
rules.validation: Check if Googlebot crawls many parameter URLs.

rules.description: Create duplicate content.
rules.implementation: Disallow sort/session params. Canonicalize tracking params.
rules.validation: Search site:yourdomain.com inurl:sort. Block if indexed.

rules.description: Multiple hops waste budget.
rules.implementation: Single-hop redirects. Update internal links to final URLs.
rules.validation: Crawl for chains. Target zero.

rules.description: Stale pages consume budget without value.
rules.implementation: Audit zero-traffic pages (12+ months). Improve, consolidate, noindex, or 410.
rules.validation: GSC data. Identify zero-click pages.

rules.description: Explicitly confirmed as ranking factor.
rules.implementation: Active social presence. Share content. Engage authoritative accounts.
rules.validation: Monitor Bing rankings with social activity.

rules.description: Bing respects Crawl-delay in robots.txt.
rules.implementation: User-agent: Bingbot / Crawl-delay: 5. Only if needed.
rules.validation: Check Bing Webmaster Tools crawl rate.

rules.description: Push protocol for immediate updates.
rules.implementation: Generate key. Host file. POST URLs on changes.
rules.validation: Bing Webmaster Tools IndexNow status.

rules.description: Requires separate submission.
rules.implementation: Bing Webmaster Tools. Verify site. Submit sitemap.
rules.validation: Verify submitted and processed.

rules.description: Bing's own structured data validator.
rules.implementation: Test with Bing Markup Validator alongside Google Rich Results Test.
rules.validation: Run key pages. Fix Bing-specific issues.

rules.description: Bing recommends under 65.
rules.implementation: Aim under 65 characters.
rules.validation: Check against 65-char limit.

rules.description: Regular updates rank better in Bing.
rules.implementation: Update regularly. Show modified dates. dateModified in schema.
rules.validation: Ensure important pages updated quarterly.

rules.description: Well-structured URLs help Bing understand architecture.
rules.implementation: Descriptive, hierarchical. Max 3-4 levels. Hyphens.
rules.validation: Review structure for depth and cleanliness.

google_discover.name: Google Discover
google_discover.description: Rules for Google Discover feed optimization.

rules.description: No special registration. Algorithmic selection.
rules.implementation: Standard SEO. Engaging content. No special implementation.
rules.validation: GSC > Performance > Discover.

rules.description: For large image treatment.
rules.implementation: 1200px+ wide. 16:9 preferred. High quality.
rules.validation: Check dimensions. 1200x675 meets both.

rules.description: Best display for large cards.
rules.validation: Check featured image ratios.

rules.description: Required for large image format.
rules.implementation: <meta name='robots' content='max-image-preview:large'>.
rules.validation: Check meta robots. No conflicting directives.

rules.description: Prohibited by Discover policies.
rules.implementation: Honest titles. No misleading thumbnails. Text overlay <20%.
rules.validation: Review titles and images.

rules.description: Volatile. Don't depend on it.
rules.implementation: Focus on standard SEO. Discover = bonus.
rules.validation: Monitor but focus on organic search.

rules.description: Selected by algorithm. Optimize structure for eligibility.
rules.implementation: Question headings. Direct answers. Lists, tables, definitions.
rules.validation: Search target queries. Optimize page 1 content.

rules.description: Remove from featured snippets.
rules.implementation: Full: <meta content='nosnippet'>. Selective: data-nosnippet. nosnippet removes ALL snippets.
rules.validation: Verify opt-out intentional.

rules.description: Low max-snippet makes selection unlikely but not guaranteed.
rules.implementation: max-snippet:50 discourages. Use nosnippet for guaranteed prevention.
rules.validation: Verify value low enough (<50 chars).

rules.description: Different content for bots vs users = severe violation.
rules.implementation: Never serve different HTML by user-agent. Content must match.
rules.validation: URL Inspection vs browser. Check for user-agent routing.

rules.description: Invisible text (white-on-white, font-size:0) = penalties.
rules.implementation: No same-color text, font-size:0, off-screen positioning. Exception: sr-only.
rules.validation: Search CSS for hiding techniques on content text.

rules.description: Unnatural repetition is spam signal.
rules.implementation: Write naturally. 2-3 keyword uses. Synonyms.
rules.validation: Read aloud. Density <3%. Check alt and meta.

rules.description: Buying/selling links, exchanges, PBNs.
rules.implementation: Never buy links. rel='sponsored'. Natural earning.
rules.validation: Audit practices. GSC manual actions.

rules.description: Low-quality pages for keyword variations.
rules.implementation: Every page: unique value. No location-only variations.
rules.validation: Check for similar pages targeting slight variations.

rules.description: Copying without adding value violates policies.
rules.implementation: Original content. Add analysis if referencing. Attribute.
rules.validation: Copyscape. GSC manual actions.

rules.description: Different destinations for bots and users.
rules.implementation: Same destination for all. No user-agent routing.
rules.validation: Test as browser and bot. Same destination.

rules.description: Fake reviews, fabricated ratings, invisible markup.
rules.implementation: Only visible, genuine content. Real ratings. Never fabricate.
rules.validation: Verify visible counterpart for every structured property.

rules.description: Mass thin content without human oversight.
rules.implementation: Human oversight required. AI content OK if reviewed and valuable.
rules.validation: Review quality. Flag machine-generated without editing.

rules.description: Full-screen popups on mobile = ranking penalty.
rules.implementation: No popups on mobile load. OK: small banners, legal notices.
rules.validation: Mobile from search. No blocking popups.

monitoring_tools.name: Monitoring & Validation Tools
monitoring_tools.description: Essential SEO monitoring and validation tools.

rules.description: Authoritative for Google indexing, performance, CWV, manual actions.
rules.implementation: Verify site. Weekly: Performance, Indexing, CWV, Manual actions.
rules.validation: GSC set up. Pages indexed. No manual actions.

rules.description: Bing insights, IndexNow, Markup Validator.
rules.implementation: Verify. Submit sitemaps. IndexNow. Review reports.
rules.validation: Setup verified. Sitemap processed.

rules.description: Validates structured data, shows rich result eligibility.
rules.implementation: Test every page type. Fix all errors.
rules.validation: Run on representative pages. Zero errors.

rules.description: General spec validation. Catches issues Google misses.
rules.implementation: Test at validator.schema.org. Use with Rich Results Test.
rules.validation: Run key pages. Fix compliance issues.

rules.description: Lab and field CWV data.
rules.implementation: Test key pages. Address Opportunities. Aim 90+.
rules.validation: Run on key pages. Track scores.

rules.description: Comprehensive performance, accessibility, SEO audits.
rules.implementation: Lighthouse on key pages. All categories. SEO 90+. Performance 80+.
rules.validation: Run Lighthouse. Address flagged issues.

rules.description: Desktop crawler finding technical issues.
rules.implementation: Monthly crawl (free 500 URLs). Broken links, duplicates, missing meta, redirects.
rules.validation: Full crawl. Fix identified issues.

rules.rule: Core Web Vitals report in GSC
rules.description: Real-world CWV data by status and metric.
rules.implementation: Monthly review. Focus on 'Poor'. Diagnose with PageSpeed.
rules.validation: All URLs 'Good'. Fix 'Poor' first.

rules.description: Conform to spec with self-referencing atom:link.
rules.implementation: RSS 2.0 with xmlns:atom and atom:link rel='self'. Validate at w3.org/feed/.
rules.validation: Validate. Check atom:link. Test in readers.

rules.description: Reflect most recent content update.
rules.implementation: RFC 822 date of most recent item or generation time.
rules.validation: Check lastBuildDate matches recent update.

rules.description: Categorize each feed item.
rules.implementation: <category> on each <item>. Match site taxonomy.
rules.validation: Each item has category. Consistent taxonomy.

rules.description: No 404 links in feed. Current content.
rules.implementation: Regenerate on changes. Remove deleted. Automate in build.
rules.validation: Check item links. None 404.

rules.description: Practical limits. Paginate if needed.
rules.implementation: 50-100 recent items. Category feeds for large libraries.
rules.validation: Check size and count.

indexnow_protocol.name: IndexNow Protocol
indexnow_protocol.description: Rules for IndexNow instant URL notification.

rules.description: Notify search engines immediately on content changes.
rules.implementation: Generate key at bing.com/indexnow. Host key file. POST URLs on changes.
rules.validation: Key file accessible. Bing Webmaster Tools status.

rules.rule: Supported by Bing, Yandex, ChatGPT feeds
rules.description: Shared across participants. Google not yet.
rules.implementation: Submit to api.indexnow.org. Auto-shared. Continue sitemaps for Google.
rules.validation: Bing Webmaster Tools confirmation.
